chapters.title: What Scorecard does
chapters.standfirst: A descriptive manual kit — not a grader. Agents scaffold; authors confirm in Write mode.

blocks.text: Scorecard turns a repository into a factual site: job, feature status, run steps, and optional manual chapters. Content lives as JSON under content/; this Vite app is the preview and Write surface.
Use npx scorecard-kit dev for local Write mode, scorecard-kit check before handoff, and scorecard-kit demos to compare specimen project shapes.

chapters.title: How a guide is built
chapters.standfirst: Your project name appears in the sidebar pixel wordmark; chapters are filled from interview + scan evidence.

blocks.text: Standard and Full sites use the Libretto-style shell: hamburger table of contents, chapter ruler, and editorial contents rows. Lite stays a single summary page.

faqs.question: Does Scorecard grade my project?
faqs.answer: No. It describes status and evidence only.

faqs.question: Where does the product title come from?
faqs.answer: manual.projectName drives the pixel wordmark and "<Project Name> Guide" title. Scorecard appears only as platform attribution in the footer.
